PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_LEAD_SOURCES.description: Returns all lead sources. Please note that the list of lead sources is fixed, it cannot be modified. All leads created through the Pipedrive API will have a lead source `API` assigned.

AGENCYZOOM_GET_A_LIST_OF_LEAD_SOURCE_CAT.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of all predefined lead source categories from AgencyZoom, used to classify lead origins.

AGENCYZOOM_GET_A_LIST_OF_LEAD_SOURCES.description: Fetches a list of all lead sources configured in AgencyZoom, including their ID, name, sales exclusion status, and category ID.

AGENCYZOOM_CREATE_LEAD.description: Creates a new lead or updates an existing one in AgencyZoom; ensure `pipelineId`, `stageId`, `leadSourceId`, and `assignTo` reference valid, existing entities.

zip.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the lead's address.

city.description: The city of the lead's address.

name.description: The name of the organization or company, required if 'isBusiness' is True.

csrId.description: The unique identifier of the Customer Service Representative (CSR) assigned to the lead.

email.description: The primary email address of the lead.

examples: Interested in auto and home bundle. Called on Monday.
notes.description: Additional notes or comments about the lead.

phone.description: The primary phone number of the lead.

state.description: The state or province of the lead's address (e.g., CA, TX, NY).

xDate.description: The X-date (e.g., policy expiration or renewal date) associated with the lead, preferably in YYYY-MM-DD format.

country.description: The country of the lead's address (e.g., US, CA).

stageId.description: The unique identifier of the stage within the specified pipeline where the lead will be placed.

assignTo.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the producer or agent to whom the lead is assigned.

birthday.description: The lead's date of birth, in MM/DD/YY format.

lastname.description: The last name of the lead.

nickname.description: An informal name or nickname for the lead.

soldDate.description: The date when the lead was marked as sold, preferably in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tagNames.description: A single string containing multiple tag names, separated by semicolons (;). These tags help categorize or segment the lead.

firstname.description: The first name of the lead.

groupCode.description: The group code associated with the lead, if applicable.

otherCsrs.description: A list of unique identifiers for other Customer Service Representatives (CSRs) also assigned to or associated with this lead.

quoteDate.description: The date when a quote was provided to the lead, preferably in YYYY-MM-DD format.

isBusiness.description: Indicates whether the lead is a business entity (True) or an individual consumer (False).

middlename.description: The middle name of the lead.

pipelineId.description: The unique identifier of the sales pipeline to which the lead will be added.

contactDate.description: The date of the last contact with the lead, preferably in YYYY-MM-DD format.

agencyNumber.description: The agency location code associated with the lead, if applicable.

fieldName.description: Name of the custom field. To find available field names, refer to the GET /v1/api/custom-field-definitions endpoint or your AgencyZoom custom field settings.

fieldValue.description: Value(s) for the custom field. For most custom field types, this will be a list containing a single string. For custom fields that support multiple selections (e.g., multi-select dropdowns), this can be a list of strings.

items.description: Request schema for custom fields when creating or updating a lead.

customFields.description: A list of custom field objects, each specifying a field name and its value(s) for the lead.

leadSourceId.description: The unique identifier of the lead source (e.g., 'Website', 'Referral').

maritalStatus.description: An integer code representing the lead's marital status. The specific mapping of integers to statuses (e.g., 1 for Single, 2 for Married) should be confirmed within your AgencyZoom system configuration or API documentation.

streetAddress.description: The primary street address of the lead.

departmentCode.description: The department code associated with the lead, if applicable.

otherProducers.description: A list of unique identifiers for other producers or agents also assigned to or associated with this lead.

secondaryEmail.description: An alternative or secondary email address for the lead.

secondaryPhone.description: An alternative or secondary phone number for the lead.

assignmentGroupId.description: The unique identifier of the assignment group responsible for the lead.

nextExpirationDate.description: The next important expiration date related to the lead (e.g., current policy expiration), in MM/DD/YY format.

streetAddressLine2.description: Additional street address information (e.g., apartment, suite, or unit number).
